title: Christmas Magic
intro: [excited] Ho ho ho! Welcome to a very merry Christmas episode of Disney Jeopardy! Grab your cocoa, hang your stocking, and [whispers] try to stay on the nice list. [laughs]

art.prompt: A snowy fairy-tale town square at night with a giant twinkling Christmas tree, garland-wrapped lampposts, wrapped presents piled by a gazebo, a castle silhouette glowing with icicle lights in the distance, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Tinsel Town Movies
categories.intro: We start with the holiday movies that come out of the attic every December. [chuckles]

art.prompt: A cozy holiday movie night: a crackling fireplace with stockings, a big red velvet suit on a coat rack, a sleigh bell, a mug of steaming cocoa and a vintage film projector glowing, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Mickey's Christmas Carol, Mickey Mouse plays this loyal, underpaid clerk who works for Scrooge.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bob Cratchit! He even asks for half of Christmas Day off. [sighs] Scrooge's answer? Very chilly.

clues.clue: In The Santa Clause, Scott Calvin becomes Santa after he puts on this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Santa's suit! Read the fine print, folks. [laughs] That card was a binding contract.

clues.clue: In The Muppet Christmas Carol, this Muppet narrates the story as Charles Dickens himself.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gonzo! With Rizzo the Rat as his sidekick. [chuckles] Light the lamp, not the rat!

clues.clue: In Noelle, Santa's daughter searches for her runaway brother Nick in this sunny U.S. city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phoenix, Arizona! Nick goes there to relax on a yoga retreat. [laughs] Santa in the desert. Very little snow.

clues.clue: In The Santa Clause, this elf serves Scott Calvin hot cocoa she says took 1,200 years to perfect.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Judy! Not too hot, extra chocolate, shaken not stirred. [excited] I want that recipe.

categories.title: Snow on Main Street
categories.intro: Next, Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party at Magic Kingdom. [excited] Cookies, cocoa and snow in Florida!

art.prompt: A turn-of-the-century small-town main street at night decorated with garlands and wreaths, gentle snowflakes falling under glowing street lamps, a parade float of toy soldiers in the distance, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: At Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party, guests get free cookies and cups of this warm drink.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is hot cocoa! [chuckles] Pro tip: dunk the cookie.

clues.clue: It actually 'snows' every party night on this Magic Kingdom street.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Main Street, U.S.A.! The snow is soap bubbles. [whispers] Don't try to catch it with your tongue.

clues.clue: This jolly figure rides on the last float of Mickey's Once Upon a Christmastime Parade.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Santa Claus! He always closes the parade. [laughs] He's saving his energy for the big night.

clues.clue: The very first Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party was held for one night in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1983! One night only, December 16th. [excited] Now it runs most of the season.

clues.clue: Debuting in 2019, Minnie's Wonderful Christmastime Fireworks replaced this long-running party fireworks show.
accept: holiday wishes: celebrate the spirit of the season
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Holiday Wishes! It sparkled over the castle for years. [sighs] Then Minnie took over the sky.

categories.title: By Candlelight
categories.intro: Now, a sweet EPCOT tradition: the Candlelight Processional. [whispers] Choir voices, please.

art.prompt: A grand outdoor theater at night, rows of glowing candles held aloft forming a tiered evergreen shape, a full orchestra under twinkling lights, a single bright star shining above the stage, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: A celebrity narrator at EPCOT's Candlelight Processional reads this story aloud.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Christmas story, the Nativity. [whispers] With a mass choir and a fifty-piece orchestra backing it up.

clues.clue: The Candlelight Processional is held at America Gardens Theatre, part of this World Showcase pavilion.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the American Adventure! Right in the middle of World Showcase. [chuckles] Fitting for a show that started with Walt.

clues.clue: The choir members, in green robes, stand on risers to form this living holiday decoration.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Christmas tree, the living Christmas tree! [excited] Best tree you'll ever hear.

clues.clue: Guests can guarantee a seat for the processional by booking a meal deal called a Candlelight this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Candlelight Dining Package! Dinner plus a seat. [laughs] Feed your stomach and your soul.

clues.clue: The processional's grand finale is the Hallelujah chorus, from this oratorio by George Frideric Handel.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Messiah! [gasps] When that chorus hits, the whole theater gets goosebumps.

categories.title: Deck the Parks
categories.intro: Picture time! Every photo is a real Disney park all dressed up for the holidays. [excited] Tell me what you're looking at.

art.prompt: A collage of holiday park decorations without people: icicle lights on castle towers, giant ornaments, wreaths on a clock tower, garland on a carousel, a glowing tree on a town square, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This Magic Kingdom castle is wearing its holiday icicle lights. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella Castle! [gasps] Like it's been dipped in ice and sprinkled with stars.

clues.clue: Name this Disneyland boat ride, which gets a holiday makeover with Jingle Bells mixed into its famous song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is it's a small world, in its holiday version! [laughs] Now the song gets stuck in your head with sleigh bells on.

clues.clue: Each holiday season since 2001, this Disneyland haunt gets an overlay themed to which Tim Burton-produced film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Nightmare Before Christmas! Haunted Mansion Holiday. [chuckles] Jack Skellington redecorates, and the ghosts get presents.

clues.clue: This frosty holiday castle, the first castle Disney ever built, is in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disneyland! Sleeping Beauty Castle, open since 1955. [whispers] Every winter it gets snowy rooftops and icicles.

clues.clue: Disneyland's giant Main Street Christmas tree stands each year in this spot near the park entrance.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Town Square! It's the first thing you see after the train station. [excited] Instant Christmas.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

categories.title: Stocking Stuffer Emoji
categories.intro: Finally, holiday movies in emoji! I give you the emoji and a hint, you give me the title. [laughs]

art.prompt: A row of knitted Christmas stockings hung on a mantel, each overflowing with little toys, candy canes, a toy sleigh and a snow globe, warm firelight glowing below, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: ❄️👭⛄👑 Hint: two royal sisters and a snowman who loves warm hugs.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen! [chuckles] Not technically a Christmas movie. But it's very, very cold.

clues.clue: 🎅🧥🦌👦 Hint: a dad puts on the red suit and his son's belief saves Christmas.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Santa Clause! [laughs] With an E at the end, because it's a legal clause.

clues.clue: 🦆💰👻👻👻 Hint: a rich, stingy duck meets three spirits.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey's Christmas Carol! [laughs] Bah, humbug, quack quack.

clues.clue: 🎃💀➡️🎄🎁 Hint: a skeleton king tries his hand at Santa's job.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Nightmare Before Christmas! [chuckles] Halloween and Christmas in one movie. That's efficient.

clues.clue: 🧝🧝🏠✅🎅 Hint: this 2009 TV special follows elves who get houses ready before Santa arrives.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Prep and Landing! Wayne and Lanny, elite elves of Christmas. [whispers] Mission accomplished.
